translation.info-intro-p1: This little website is a tool to plan your pizza party.
translation.info-intro-p2: More specifically, it will help you choose the right amount of specific diet pizzas for your guests.
translation.info-intro-p3: For instance, imagine you want to create a buffet of pizza for <pink>7 persons</pink>, one of them is <green>vegetarian</green>, 2 are <blue>pesco-vegetarian</blue> and one is <orange>vegan</orange>, and the last 3 eats meat (I will call them <red>omnivorous</red> for simplicity).
translation.info-intro-p4: <bold>How much of which pizza should you order?</bold>
translation.info-intro-p5: One might make the assumption that you can order <red>3 pizzas with meat</red>, <blue>two with fish</blue>, <green>one vegetarian</green> and <orange>one vegan</orange>. But one would be <bold>wrong!</bold>
translation.info-theorem-title: The theorem of everyone loves the 4 cheese
translation.info-theorem-p2: That's right! One very common choice for a <green>vegetarian</green> pizza is the 4 cheese, but <red>omnivorous</red> and <blue>pesco-vegetarian</blue> will eat a bit of that too.
translation.info-theorem-p3: Once the most permissive pizzas in terms of diet are depleted, the remaining slices will be exclusive to the most permissive diets. Leaving restrictive diets behind.
translation.info-theorem-p4: One might have already noted that, in such circumstances, even one single pizza with meat will give advantage to <red>omnivorous</red> people. One is right, but this problem can be greatly mitigated. We'll see how.
translation.light-people-label: Select de number of people of each diet.
translation.light-quantity-label: Select the amount of pizza per person.
translation.light-suggestion-title: Here are the pizzas you should order:
translation.light-suggestion-flag: Those flags indicate how fair is your order for each diet.
translation.light-why: (Why would you even use this site ?)
translation.light-about-p1: First, enter how many people of each diet will attend your party using the following indicators:
translation.light-about-p2: Then, choose how much pizza per person you want to have, then click on the big <computeButton /> button.
translation.light-about-p3: The site will then suggest the most fair solution.
translation.light-about-p4: <bold>You like it?</bold> Perfect, you can use it and close the site.
translation.light-about-p5: <bold>You don't like it?</bold> You have multiple solution to make it suits your needs.
translation.light-about-p6: To modify the solution, you have the following options:
translation.light-about-p7: You can use the <moreButton/> buttons next to each type of pizza that allows you to ask for suggestion that contains at least one more of that pizza type.
translation.light-about-p8: You can also click on <modifyButton/> to edit manually how much of each type of pizza you want. To help you keep the right amount of pizza, the following indicator appears:
translation.light-about-p8-short: You can also click on <modifyButtonShort/> to edit manually how much of each type of pizza you want. To help you keep the right amount of pizza, the following indicator appears:
translation.light-about-p9: You can also click on <moreFairButton/> which will modify the suggestion a little to make it more fair.
translation.light-about-p10: ⚠ Be careful ! Using the two options above will make the order less fair.
translation.light-about-p11: To tell how fair is your order, you can use the indicator that looks like this:
translation.light-about-p12: These indicator shows how much, in average, a person from each diet will eat. Simply compare the quantity of each diet to see if the order seems fair to you. For instance here, omnivorous people will eat 9 slices in average, and vegetarian will eat 6. That is not very fair.
translation.light-about-p13: There ! You know it all ! Have a nice pizza party !
translation.light-warning-edit-text: By editing the suggestion manually, you may make it less fair, keep an eye on the indicator of the quantity eaten by each diets.
translation.light-warning-plus-text: By adding {{pizza}}, you will make the suggestion less fair.
